info.name: Azure Monitor Action Groups Events API
Azure Monitor Get events by type

params.name: appId
params.description: ID of the Application Insights component. This is the Application ID from the API Access settings blade in the Azure portal.

params.name: eventType
params.description: The type of events to query.

params.name: timespan
params.description: The timespan over which to query in ISO 8601 duration format.

params.name: $filter
params.description: An expression used to filter the returned events.

params.name: $search
params.description: A free-text search expression to match for whether a particular event should be returned.

params.name: $orderby
params.description: A comma-separated list of properties with asc or desc to sort on.

params.name: $select
params.description: Limits the properties returned for each event.

params.name: $skip
params.description: The number of items to skip over before returning events.

params.name: $top
params.description: The number of events to return.

params.name: $count
params.description: Request a count of matching items included with the returned events.

params.name: $apply
params.description: An expression used for aggregation over returned events.

items.docs: Gets the results of an OData query for events of a specific type from Application Insights telemetry.
